title: Security stepped up in UK’s Jewish communities after Bondi beach shooting
summary: Police increase patrols around synagogues and other venues as tens of thousands celebrate Hanukah Bondi beach shooting – live updates British police forces are stepping up security in Jewish communities after the antisemitic terror attack that left 12 people dead on Bondi beach in Australia. The Metropolitan police said they were increasing their presence around synagogues and other venues in London, where tens of thousands of Jews are celebrating Hanukah. Continue reading...
